main_measure.name: t of OLS slope of excess 18-bar return on forecast (non-overlapping grid, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= +2 (and positive-forecast cells' mean excess > 0); reject if t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess 18-bar return of grid cells with forecast > 0

decided_by: The slope's t is +2 or more and the positive-forecast cells' mean excess return is above 0.
reading: Grid cells are rows 0, 18, 36, ... of each window with the forecast at the cell's bar; the coin's mean 18-bar return is the mean over its grid cells pooled across all its windows; the plan's 'fewer than 200 positive cells' is reported as not observable.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
